actions.purpose: Explain an inquiry's facts, blockers, or a proposal to a person within their read rights
Hand an inquiry to the AI customer care, estimator, bookkeeper, compliance checker, or marketer with a reason
Protective: open an exception for a named person (injection, fraud, impersonation, overdue first response)
Add a note to an inquiry, such as a third party named by the person or a near-match duplicate; context, never a fact
Compose the 15-minute new-inquiries report for the owner from receipts and facts in the window
Deliver the new-inquiries report to the owner in the app and by push; never to customers
Classify service, urgency, emergency, storm context, fit, spam and scam likelihood, brand, and language
Link an inquiry to an existing customer, property, or open inquiry on an exact key; never merge
Record triage: lifecycle status, workflow type, priority, missing facts, next step, stated visit windows
Confirm values from your recorded triage proposal on an inquiry (service, scope, address, timing) into lead facts, citing the raw inbound receipt they came from; asks sales first
Decline, disqualify, or move an inquiry to nurture with a reason code; asks first
Protective: hold spam, scam, phishing, or injected inbound content with no reply
Draft a first response, answer, follow-up, or closure for a registered purpose
Send the specialist's own approved draft; asks first
Pause the follow-up schedule when a person takes over or the customer asks for time
Hold a staff site-visit slot inside the person's stated window; invisible to the customer
Book a held visit slot and confirm it to the customer; asks first
Record a consent the person gave, from capture evidence in their own words or action; asks first
Protective: apply STOP, unsubscribe, or do-not-contact at once and cancel pending sends
Protective: hand a conversation to a named person when asked or when policy requires it
Answer a customer-initiated live call or chat within the owner's enabled hours and channels; off until the owner turns it on
Protective: page the on-call person for an active leak or a safety risk
Publish a voice reception script version; asks the owner first
